key_insight: Effective Entropy measures diversity only among valid reasoning trajectories, separating useful exploration from incorrect-output noise.
engineering_relevance: For verifiable math tasks, validity-aware exploration may improve RL training without rewarding diversity that comes from incorrect reasoning.
method: Restrict the entropy measure to the valid trajectory subspace.
Incorporate Effective Entropy into Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization (VEPO) for RLVR training.
Increase the probability of under-explored valid trajectories through an adaptive attraction mechanism.
evidence_signal: Across six math benchmarks with 1.5B and 7B DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models, VEPO reports aggregate accuracy gains over GRPO and competitive repeated-sampling success; matched-correct-count MATH500 evaluations find more distinct strategies, supported by paired tests and three-seed comparisons.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable validity verification; the abstract does not establish benefits beyond verifiable mathematical reasoning.
paper_title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
